text: dsh-external-session 是 DSH Web 客户端的会话持久化插件，替换默认 JSONL 后端，并按工作目录选择存储根。指定项目的会话写入项目内的 .dsh-sessions，其他工作区继续使用内部目录；还可导入项目、列出或迁移会话、查看 Git 状态，并在会话页显示外部存储标记。适合希望会话随项目仓库跨设备同步的用户。需配置项目目录与存储根；不需要 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-external-session routes DSH web sessions under configured project directories and keeps other workspaces in internal storage. It supports project import, session listing and migration, Git status, and an external-session badge. Configure project paths; no API key or external account is required.
我想把某个项目的 DSH 会话保存在项目目录里，方便跟仓库一起同步。
I want DSH sessions for a project to live in its repository so they sync with the project.
dsh-external-session 的功能「按项目保存会话」：根据会话工作目录选择内部根目录或配置的项目存储根。新会话及其日志使用对应根目录持久化，项目会话可以随仓库目录携带。
dsh-external-session 的功能「导入与管理项目会话」：在设置区选择并导入项目，查看已有会话；也可用 /external-session 命令列出、迁移会话或查看 Git 状态。

dsh-external-session README · dsh-external-session：Portable Git-backed external session persistence for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Sessions created under configured project roots are stored in `.dsh-sessions/` using clone-path-independent relative directory keys. The plugin reads legacy absolute-path layouts and remaps them when a repository is cloned elsewhere.

dsh-external-session README · Install from GitHub：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XiaoYuOvO/dsh-external-session
```

After installation, configure the project root in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`; see [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) for configuration, migration behavior, safety rules, and tests.
